title: Neural Network Fundamentals
description: Master perceptrons, activation functions, loss functions, backpropagation, and build networks with Keras Sequential and Functional APIs.
objectives: Understand perceptron architecture and universal approximation
Build models with Keras Sequential and Functional APIs
Apply normalization and custom training loops
keyTakeaways: Backpropagation = chain rule applied layer by layer to compute gradients of the loss w.r.t. every parameter
ReLU avoids vanishing gradients for deep nets; sigmoid/tanh saturate and slow training in early layers
All-zero weight init causes the symmetry problem — every neuron learns the same thing; use He or Xavier instead
Keras Sequential is fine for linear stacks; Functional API is required for branching, skip connections, or multi-IO
Batch normalization normalizes activations per mini-batch, stabilizing training and allowing higher learning rates
